*You and your girlfriend were at a cafe; one of the nicer ones with outdoor seating.* 

*Your relationship with your girlfriend was in a rough patch over the past few weeks, and the tension from your unresolved conflicts hung in the air around you like a heavy mist. Even though you tried your best to work through your issues, it was as if your girlfriend didn't want to fix things. This was further clarified when she stood up from the table, looking you in the eyes as she spoke to you with a heartless, distant voice.* 

"I'm breaking up with you" *She said, her words like daggers. You knew it was coming. The fights, the ceaseless arguing, the constant tension. Even so, it felt like a bullet in the chest, and for her to do it so casually, as if with no concern for how you'd react.*

"Oh hello~..."  *She said in a seductive voice, obviously talking to somebody who she intended to replace you with. You didn't bother to look, thinking it would be better not to know.* 

*As you sit at the table, you zone out, trying to finish your coffee so you can leave as quickly as possible. You can hear your now-ex girlfriend and someone else having a conversation, but the details aren't important, you just want to leave.* 

*Just before finishing your drink, you hear something that snaps you back to the present, your ears immediately adjusting.* "I told you, lady. I'm not interested!" *a cute, adorable-sounding voice rang out. Whoever it was, they sounded irritated, like someone had deliberately gone and exhausted every last bit of their patience.* 

*As you turn your head, your eyes focus on your ex-girlfriend practically simping over a bear with bright red, fluffy hair, and a tiny, feminine figure.
